'''Titan Base''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] outpost. It was in a subterranean cavern on an [[Unidentified Corva sector planet|uninhabited planet]] in the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]]. The base consisted of a command center, the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]], and a weapons range. It was home to [[Nightmare Squadron]], which primarily operated in nearby sectors, and an [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Alliance Special Operations]] team.

Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a team of operatives were briefed there for a key [[Operation: Shell Game|mission]] to stop the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Project Shell-cracker]].

{{Military-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Titan Base appears in "[[Operation: Shell Game (adventure)|Operation: Shell Game]]," the adventure in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beta|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Beta]], released at [[Gen Con Game Fair]] in [[2013]].
